## Featured: From job postings to training priorities

Which skills should an AI training program teach first? At Crew Scaler, I turned job descriptions into a structured skills analysis that helped the team compare training priorities. The work also surfaced a limitation: a skill appearing often in job ads is a useful signal, but it does not establish the size of the labor market.

[See the research approach and my contribution](projects/project_crew_scaler.qmd){.project-btn}
